extension.summary: Persistent HH:MM:SS.mmm timecode overlay for cross-Pi sync checking
extension.description: Kodi equivalent of this project's mpv SYNC_OVERLAY: shows the current playback position at millisecond precision, always on screen, no auto-hide. No frame counter (Kodi has no native frame-position API) — milliseconds serve the same "do these two Pis look in sync" purpose.
